name: GROUNDKEPT-kept-unread
old: if (kept && now - kept.at < REGION_GROUND_KEEP_MS) return kept.ground;
note: every board read of a region whose writs never post scans its ground - 123,000 rows, 409 ms

name: GROUNDKEPT-keep-unbounded
old: if (kept && now - kept.at < REGION_GROUND_KEEP_MS) return kept.ground;
note: an isolate's ground never read again - the writs drawn from ground days old

name: GROUNDKEPT-none-kept
note: a region read before its ground was witnessed posts nothing for the keep
